glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 辵 (“walk”) + phonetic 咼.
senses: [guò] to cross; to pass; to go across; to pass through
[guò] (of time) to pass by; to pass
[Guō] name of an ancient state in modern Shandong
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 過; s_page_origin explains the simplified 过.
